description: This source file defines an enum 'ExecApprovalCommandDisplaySanitizer' containing static methods for sanitizing strings by escaping invisible Unicode code points and format characters.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes the input string by escaping invisible Unicode characters and format characters.

methods.name: shouldEscape
methods.description: Determines if a given Unicode scalar should be escaped based on its properties and being in the set of invisible code points.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Converts a Unicode scalar into an escape sequence string in the format '\u{HEX}'
